top_signals.title: Trump Allows Tariff Relief for Some Ground Beef Imports
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump is aiming to deliver cost relief for some ground beef imports to lower prices for American consumers, by allowing up to 300,000 metric tons of product for ground beef to be imported with no out of quota tariff for the next 90 days. He also made a commitment that the beef will be sold at 25% below current market prices. Agriculture Reporter Ilena Peng and Howard Capital Management CEO Vance Howard -- who owns a ranch of his own -- discuss how much the tariff relief will impact costs, and what it may do to American farm businesses. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Strategy shares hit two-month high as STRC rebounds toward $100 alongside bitcoin
top_signals.summary: Amid a two-month puase on BTC buys, Strategy shares (MSTR) rallied alongside bitcoin as STRC continued its recovery toward its $100 target.
